# Maramao

> Maramao is a free, open-source Pomodoro timer for the macOS menu bar. You work for 25 minutes, then a cat takes over the screen so you actually take the break. Native Swift app (SwiftUI and AppKit), macOS 13 Ventura or later, Apple Silicon and Intel, MIT license, no special permissions, no tracking. The app speaks English and Italian and follows the language of the Mac. Website: https://maramao.kkratter.com/ (English) and https://maramao.kkratter.com/it/ (Italian). FAQ: https://maramao.kkratter.com/faq/

Key facts:

- Lives in the menu bar only (no Dock icon). Three rhythms in the menu: Classic 25/5, Long 50/10, Deep 90/20. A native macOS menu with Check for Updates (Sparkle auto-update) and Quit.
- Break modes, each a different cat: "Laser chase" (the mouse becomes a laser dot a drawn cat chases), "Cat invasion" (drawn cats rain down and bury the screen), "Don't wake the cat" (a full-screen photo of a sleeping cat; touch the mouse or keyboard and a photo of an angry cat appears, a different one each time), and "Surprise" (a random one each break). Pick one in the menu and use "Try Mode" to see it for 30 seconds. Italian names: Caccia al laser, Invasione di gatti, Non svegliare il gatto, Sorpresa.
- During a break the screen shows only the cat, a paw, the countdown and a Close button that appears after a minute. Control-Option-Command-R snoozes a break for a few minutes, a few times a day.
- Breaks wait while the microphone or camera is in use, or a presentation or call app is fullscreen.
- The cats in Laser chase and Cat invasion are drawn in code; Don't wake the cat uses CC0 photos from the WordPress Photo Directory, bundled in the app. The website shows freely licensed videos of real cats from Wikimedia Commons.
- Automation: `maramao://start`, `maramao://pause`, `maramao://break`, `maramao://skip`, `maramao://mode/<id>` and more; Shortcuts actions; global shortcuts: Shift-Command-M starts or pauses a session, Control-Option-Command-B starts a break, -S skips, -R snoozes.
- Emergency exit from any break: Control-Option-Command-Delete, or five quick clicks in the top-left corner of a screen.

## Install

- Download the DMG from https://github.com/kkratterf/maramao/releases/latest and drag Maramao to Applications.
- Or one line in Terminal: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkratterf/maramao/main/install.sh | sh`
- Or Homebrew: `brew tap kkratterf/maramao https://github.com/kkratterf/maramao && brew install --cask maramao`
- Since 0.8.0 the app is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so Gatekeeper opens it without warnings. Versions up to 0.7.0 were not notarized.
- Uninstall: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkratterf/maramao/main/install.sh | sh -s -- --uninstall`, or `brew uninstall --zap --cask maramao`.
